title: Adaptive Control of Stochastic Error Accumulation in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation
summary: In realistic hardware for quantum computation that possesses fault-tolerance, non-stationary noise and stochastic drift lead to logical failure from the temporal accumulation of errors, not from independent events. Static decoding and fixed calibration techniques are structurally incompatible with this situation because they do not take into account temporal correlations between errors or control-induced back-action of errors.
